title: Discover Niagara's Hidden Gems on a Private Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Why go on a wine tour with a minivan packed with strangers when you can have a private tour with only your companion and a few friends along for the ride? (max 6 people)
I'll pick you up from anywhere in the Niagara region in a private car.. You'll get to choose 4 venues from my select group of boutique wineries and brewpubs. My locations are smaller family owned venues that do not sell through the LCBO and give give a superior tasting experience. 
I am more than just a shuttle service taking you from one spot to the next with little information or context about your experiences. With a small group I can interact more easily with my guests as we tour wine country.
Not just wine, I add some sightseeing, background of the wine region, and a little Niagara history. i'll even stop at fruit stands and a jam seller along the way.
